purpose: Teach: 完備/部局/蓄え/出向い/改築/仮設/通さ/まずまず

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、新庁舎、本気で、設備、完備、進めております、絶対、市民の安全、第一に、本気で、頑張ってまいります、本気。
lines.en: The police department is moving forward with our new headquarters project. We're serious about completing all necessary facilities with safety for our citizens as the absolute priority.
lines.style: Measured and formal, like reading from notes. Deliberate weight on key commitments. Clear-eyed but not warm. Professional cadence, steady breathing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察関連の、各部局、本気で、連携、強化しております、絶対、感謝、しております、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our company is strengthening coordination with all police departments. We're genuinely grateful for this partnership and we're committed to supporting it.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal but warmer than official. Nods along. Respectful without stiffness. Eager to show alignment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯資金の蓄え、本気で、必要、感じております、絶対、市民の皆様、ご協力、お願いいたします、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Crime prevention funding reserves are something we're taking very seriously. We need the community's cooperation and support.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Each clause lands clearly. Slight pause before the request — giving weight to what he's about to ask.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様、当社に、出向いた、本日、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、お話、聞かせていただきます、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We're very grateful that the police came to visit us today. We'd like to hear more about what you need from us.
lines.style: Warm opening, then becomes more attentive. Leaning in slightly. Genuine interest in what comes next.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察署の改築、本気で、進めております、絶対、市民の皆様、しばらく、ご迷惑、お掛けします、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The police station renovation is underway. We know it will inconvenience the community for a while, and we appreciate your patience.
lines.style: Apologetic undertone without overdoing it. Calm, straightforward. A small dip in tone when acknowledging the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仮設の警察活動、本気で、応援、続けてまいります、絶対、本気で、地域、皆、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll continue supporting the temporary police operations in the area. The whole community is grateful for everything you do.
lines.style: Supportive and calm. Speaks as if on behalf of the community. Even pace, steady commitment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、警戒線を、本気で、通さなかった、警察の活躍、絶対、市民、感謝、いただきたいです、本気で、本当に、本気。
lines.en: We're grateful for how the police managed the scene with the suspect — keeping people safe behind the alert line. That kind of professionalism is what we appreciate.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight emphasis on the specific action taken. Professional admiration without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期、警察、まずまずの、結果、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、引き続き、ご活躍、お願いいたします、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. This term the police have delivered solid results. We're genuinely thankful, and we look forward to continuing to work together.
lines.style: Warm closing tone. Slightly more relaxed than earlier exchanges. Genuine appreciation, forward-looking.
